title: Peak Capacity of ActiveSG Gyms and Considerations for Building New Ones
what_it_is: Peak Capacity of ActiveSG Gyms and Considerations for Building New Ones

sections.label: ActiveSG gym peak capacity
sections.summary: The peak capacity of each ActiveSG gym is set to maximise access while ensuring sufficient space, time and fire safety compliance.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Goh Hanyan) (for the Acting Minister for Culture, Community and Youth)
sentences.text: The peak capacity of each ActiveSG gym is set with a view to maximise access to the gym facilities while ensuring that each user has sufficient space and time to exercise and that the prevailing fire safety requirements are complied with.

sections.label: Gym locations and expansion plans
sections.summary: Gyms with higher visitorship relative to size include Senja-Cashew and Clementi, and every residential town is planned to have a gym.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Goh Hanyan) (for the Acting Minister for Culture, Community and Youth)
sentences.text: Some examples of gyms that experience higher visitorship relative to their size include Senja-Cashew ActiveSG gym and Clementi ActiveSG gym.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Goh Hanyan) (for the Acting Minister for Culture, Community and Youth)
sentences.text: We plan that every residential town has at least one gym, which is situated in the town's ActiveSG Sport Centre.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Goh Hanyan) (for the Acting Minister for Culture, Community and Youth)
sentences.text: Existing ActiveSG gyms within our sport centres may be expanded when the centres undergo renovation or comprehensive redevelopment.

sections.label: Gym planning considerations
sections.summary: Planning areas with populations above 130,000 will have a town sports centre with a gym, and other formats are under review.

sentences.speaker: Ms Goh Hanyan
sentences.text: First, on the considerations before building an ActiveSG gym, for the Urban Redevelopment Authority's planning areas that have populations above 130,000, there will be a town sports centre with a gym.

sentences.speaker: Ms Goh Hanyan
sentences.text: And in terms of the second question on other locations that we might consider for such gym facilities, we will continue to review different formats as part of our Sports Facilities Master Plan.
